results.title: The book picker: type and Enter, hold for a new tab
results.checks: From Romans 8, Books → type 'John 3' and Enter opens John 3 (the book named, not 1 John); '1 John 2' and Enter opens 1 John 2. On an iPhone 13, holding a finger on John's chapter 5 opens John 5 in a new tab, the old one kept
results.note: John 3 and 1 John 2 by typing; a held finger opened John 5 in a new tab beside John 3, John 5
